output.summary: A deciduous tree native to eastern North America, shining sumac has compound leaves with winged central stalks. Its glossy foliage turns brilliant orange-red in autumn, while showy red fruit clusters persist into winter; the sour fruits are edible and can make a lemonade-like drink.
output.edibilityNote: The sour fruits are edible and can be made into a lemonade-like drink; Native Americans also added them to drinking water for lemony flavour.
